verifications.claim: Vaccines prevent millions of deaths annually.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Immunization currently prevents 3.5 million to 5 million deaths every year
verifications.reasoning: R7 directly states vaccines prevent 3.5-5 million deaths annually, matching 'millions of deaths annually' precisely.

verifications.claim: Live-attenuated vaccines use a weakened form of the virus or bacteria.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Live-Attenuated Vaccines These vaccines contain a weakened form of the virus or bacteria.
verifications.reasoning: R9 exactly matches the description of live-attenuated vaccines.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R9 lists MMR as an example under live-attenuated vaccines.

verifications.claim: Inactivated vaccines use a killed version of the germ.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Inactivated Vaccines These vaccines use a killed version of the germ.

verifications.claim: The polio vaccine is an inactivated vaccine.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R9 lists Polio (IPV) under inactivated vaccines; IPV is the inactivated polio vaccine.

verifications.claim: Subunit/recombinant/conjugate vaccines use specific pieces of the germ such as its protein or shell.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Subunit, Recombinant, and Conjugate Vaccines These vaccines use only specific parts of the germ (like proteins or sugars)
verifications.reasoning: R9 directly describes using specific parts like proteins, aligning with 'protein or shell'.

verifications.claim: Toxoid vaccines use toxins made by the germ to create immunity to the disease rather than the germ itself.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Toxoid Vaccines These vaccines protect against harmful toxins produced by bacteria, rather than the bacteria itself.
verifications.reasoning: R9 precisely matches the description of using toxins rather than the germ.

verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference classifies Tdap specifically as a toxoid vaccine; R9 lists tetanus/diphtheria as toxoids and pertussis (in DTaP) under subunit.

verifications.claim: MRNA vaccines provide instructions for cells to make a protein that triggers an immune response.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: mRNA Vaccines A newer technology that teaches cells to make a protein that triggers an immune response.
verifications.reasoning: R9 exactly matches the mRNA mechanism description.

verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.reasoning: R9 lists COVID-19 vaccines (specific ones like Pfizer/Moderna) under mRNA, but not all COVID-19 vaccines are mRNA; broader support but not comprehensive.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources list diphtheria as vaccine-preventable.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources list tetanus as vaccine-preventable.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources list pertussis as vaccine-preventable.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources list measles as vaccine-preventable.

verifications.claim: The HPV vaccine prevents certain types of cancer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: cervical cancer (R4, via HPV); cervical cancer (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources link HPV vaccine to preventing cervical cancer.

verifications.claim: Routine childhood vaccinations are generally started at birth.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference explicitly states routine childhood vaccinations start at birth; some imply early vaccines like Hep B but not directly.

verifications.claim: Tdap is a vaccine against tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: stay up-to-date with their Tdap vaccine
verifications.reasoning: R1 mentions Tdap, and its name (Tetanus-diphtheria-acellular Pertussis) directly supports the diseases listed.

verifications.claim: Vaccines are available through pediatricians, family doctors, public health clinics, and many pharmacies.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: pharmacists can help... Walgreens (R1); Pediatricians (R2 implied); Health Care Providers (R3); Health Department (R5 clinics)
verifications.reasoning: Sources cover pharmacies (R1), pediatricians/AAP (R2), providers/CDC (R3), public health clinics (R5).
